items.text: Karari packages/core/injector/instance-wrapper.ts isDependencyTreeStatic veriyor; Scope.REQUEST bagimlilik agacinda yukari yayilir (bir bagimlilik static degilse wrapper da static degildir).
Agac introspectDepsAttribute ile dolasilir: constructor dependencies, properties ve enhancers; lookupRegistry donguleri engeller.
packages/core/router/router-explorer.ts: isRequestScoped = !isDependencyTreeStatic() -> createRequestScopedHandler (her istekte controller yeniden cozulur).

Durable: isDependencyTreeDurable, durable bayragi ve ContextIdStrategy (context id getParent ile ortak/kiraci bazli context) karari degistirir; non-durable tek bir request provider agaci non-durable yapar.
Sonuc: evet, controller (durable degilse) her istekte yeniden olusturulur.

Sira: ContextCreator.createContext (packages/core/helpers/context-creator.ts:16) global, sinif, metot sirasiyla birlestirir; RouterExceptionFilters.create (packages/core/router/router-exception-filters.ts:25) filters.reverse() ile metot > controller > global yapar (en ozel once). Global: useGlobalFilters (config.getGlobalFilters) ve APP_FILTER (scanner.ts getApplyProvidersMap -> addGlobalFilter; request-scoped olanlar addGlobalRequestFilter ile, getGlobalMetadata'da eklenir).

Esleme: ExceptionsHandler.next (packages/core/exceptions/exceptions-handler.ts:14) -> invokeCustomFilters -> selectExceptionFilterMetadata (packages/common/utils/select-exception-filter-metadata.util.ts): ilk eslesen filtre (bos exceptionMetatypes = @Catch() hepsini yakalar, ya da exception instanceof); yalniz o calisir.

Senaryo sonucu: metot filtresi @Catch(BadRequestException) NotFoundException'i yakalamaz (instanceof degil); siradaki controller @Catch() filtresi yakalar ve o calisir; global filtreler (useGlobalFilters ve APP_FILTER) calismaz.

Sinif olarak verilen filtre: BaseExceptionFilterContext.getFilterInstance (packages/core/exceptions/base-exception-filter-context.ts:41): catch metodu olan nesne oldugu gibi kullanilir; sinif ise modulun injectable'larindan DI ile cozulur (getInstanceByMetatype, context id'ye gore); exceptionMetatypes @Catch metadata'sindan (reflectCatchExceptions).
Hic eslesme yoksa: super.catch -> BaseExceptionFilter.catch: HttpException ise kendi status/cevabi (NotFoundException -> 404), degilse handleUnknownError -> 500 'Internal server error'.

Moduller arasi sira: NestApplicationContext.getModulesToTriggerHooksOn (packages/core/nest-application-context.ts:502) modulleri distance'a gore buyukten kucuge siralar (b.distance - a.distance); init ve bootstrap bu sirayla, destroy/beforeShutdown/shutdown .reverse() ile ters sirayla calisir. Distance: DependenciesScanner.calculateModulesDistance (scanner.ts:~415-432) TopologyTree ile kok modulden derinlik; global moduller Number.MAX_VALUE (injector/container.ts:182) -> global modullerin init hook'lari once, kapanis hook'lari en son.

Faz sirasi: init() once tum modullerde callInitHook (onModuleInit), sonra callBootstrapHook (onApplicationBootstrap) (nest-application-context.ts:257). Kapanis: runShutdownSequence -> callDestroyHook -> callBeforeShutdownHook(signal) -> dispose() -> callShutdownHook(signal) (nest-application-context.ts:292-303).

Modul ici sira: callModuleInitHook (hooks/on-module-init.hook.ts) getInstancesGroupedByHierarchyLevel ile hierarchyLevel'e gore gruplar; init/bootstrap'ta seviyeler artan (getSortedHierarchyLevels ASC), destroy/shutdown'da azalan ('DESC'); ayni seviye Promise.all ile paralel, seviyeler sirayla. hierarchyLevel = bagimliliklarin en buyuk seviyesi + 1 (injector/injector.ts:200, 390-391) -> bagimlilik, kendisine bagimli olandan once baslar.
Modul sinifinin kendi hook'u: providers'in ilk elemani modul sinifidir, shift ile ayrilir; tum provider/controller/injectable hook'larindan SONRA cagrilir (statik ise).

Request-scoped: getInstancesGroupedByHierarchyLevel (hooks/utils/get-instances-grouped-by-hierarchy-level.ts:14) !wrapper.isDependencyTreeStatic() olanlari atlar -> request-scoped (ya da ona bagimli) provider'larin hook'u cagrilmaz. Transient: getStaticTransientInstances ile statik transient ornekleri dahil edilir.

SIGTERM: enableShutdownHooks() cagrilmali (nest-application-context.ts:347) -> listenToShutdownSignals sinyal dinleyicisi kurar (varsayilan tum ShutdownSignal degerleri) -> sinyalde shutdown(signal), sonra process.kill(pid, signal) (useProcessExit ile process.exit(0)). Cagrilmazsa yalniz app.close() kapanis hook'larini tetikler.
Mesaj mi event mi: ServerTCP.handleMessage (packages/microservices/server/server-tcp.ts:~124) packet.id undefined ise handleEvent (event), id varsa request-response (mesaj).

Esleme: Server.getHandlerByPattern -> getRouteFromPattern -> normalizePattern -> transformPatternToRoute (packages/microservices/utils/transform-pattern.utils.ts): nesne pattern'lerin anahtarlari localeCompare ile siralanip string'e cevrilir (ic ice recursive) -> {cmd, role} ile {role, cmd} ayni route'a doner, ESLESIR. Sinirlar: derinlik > 5 '[MAX_DEPTH_REACHED]', > 20 anahtar '[TOO_MANY_KEYS]'.
Ayni pattern iki @MessagePattern: Server.addHandler (packages/microservices/server/server.ts:150) event degilse messageHandlers.set ile UZERINE YAZAR -> son kaydedilen tek handler calisir.

Ayni pattern iki @EventPattern: addHandler event handler'lari zincire ekler (tailRef.next = callback); ListenersController.forkJoinHandlersIfAttached (listeners-controller.ts:~195) handlerRef.next'i cagirip forkJoin ile birlestirir -> IKISI DE calisir.

match: There is no matching message handler
items.text: Eslesme yoksa mesaj: TCP istemciye status 'error' ve err: NO_MESSAGE_HANDLER "There is no matching message handler defined in the remote service." paketi gonderir (server-tcp.ts:~140, constants.ts:57).
Eslesme yoksa event: Server.handleEvent (server.ts:~233) NO_EVENT_HANDLER ile log'a hata yazar; istemciye bir sey donmez.
